blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Veteran bowler Sylvia Tesch topped the Cebu Tenpin Bowling Association (CETBA) weekly tournament on Saturday, November 7, at the SM City Cebu Bowling Center. Tesch outplayed 31 other bowlers representing various bowling clubs in Cebu to claim the top spot in the weekly tournament, which serves as a qualifier for the Bowler of the Month competition. She finished the four-game series with 801 total pinfalls, combining her 641 scratch pinfalls with 40 handicap points.
